top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed discovery: the Kane-Mele Z2 classification and quantum spin Hall prediction, and Molenkamp's observation of the quantised edge transport in HgTe quantum wells. The scope is distinct from the 2016 prize (measurable invariant of real band structures versus model-system topological phases), though the BHZ and 3D (Hasan) claims must be explicitly excluded from the citation. P002 has the cleaner two-name credit but its separation from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes and magic-wavelength priority are not verifiable from the supplied material, so it ranks second, ahead of no award because it is mature and substantive.
